comment: InitialLabelMap (v16 §6, WS-D): the checked-in compartment vocabulary that
$dispatchMac compartment names resolve through at code generation. Bits are
STABLE assignments: the map is append-only, retired names/bits are moved to
'retired' and tombstoned forever, never reused. Version bumps are deliberate
policy generations (a new lattice version), not routine edits.
The initial live set is intentionally EMPTY, matching production lattice v1
no dispatch label carries compartments today, and inventing compartment
policy ahead of the WS-G operator review of the target inventory would be a
silent policy decision. Adding the first live compartment is an append-only
edit to 'compartments' with the next free bit.
